summary.plain: The international team that built and runs the CMS experiment: several thousand physicists, engineers and students from hundreds of universities and laboratories in more than sixty countries.
summary.technical: Collaboration formed with the submission of the CMS Letter of Intent on 1 October 1992; as read in September 2026 the collaboration reports over 6000 participants from 286 institutes in more than 60 countries.
